6.   PUBLIC INTEREST COMMENTS – ON ANY ITEM

     Any member of the public wishing to address the Advisory Planning Commission on any item listed
     or not listed on the agenda may do so at this time. Comments will be limited to three minutes per
     person. TRPA encourages (but does not require) public comment on items agendized for possible
     action to be provided at the period designated for comment on agenda items, prior to the Advisory
     Planning Commission’s consideration of the proposed action.

     Individuals or groups who commented on items listed on the agenda during the prior comment
     period may be restricted from commenting again on the same item. The Advisory Planning
     Commission may deliberate or take action only if a matter has been listed on an agenda properly
     posted prior to the meeting. Responses from Advisory Planning Commission members to unlisted
     public comment topics could become deliberation on a matter without notice to the public. To
     avoid this situation and to ensure the public has notice of all matters the Advisory Planning
     Commission (APC) will consider, APC members may choose not to respond to public comments,
     except to correct factual inaccuracies, ask for staff clarification, or to ask that a matter be listed on
     a future agenda.

7.   ADJOURNMENT

Commerce, Stateline, NV.

TRPA Mission
Established in 1969, the Tahoe Regional Planning Agency was the nation’s first bi-state regional
environmental planning agency. Our mission is to lead the cooperative effort to preserve, restore, and
enhance the unique natural and human environment of the Lake Tahoe Region, while improving local
communities, and people’s interactions with our irreplaceable environment.




                                    APC Meeting Instructions
To Participate:
    • Join in-person at 128 Market Street, Stateline, NV 89449.
    • Visit trpa.gov for all meeting resources, including:
            o Agendas and detailed packets – available at least seven days before each meeting.
            o Virtual and call-in details – available at least one day before each meeting.
    • For questions, contact TRPA staff at virtualmeetinghelp@trpa.gov or (775) 588-4547.
    • TRPA will make reasonable efforts to assist and accommodate handicapped persons that wish to
        participate. For assistance, contact Tracy Campbell, tcampbell@trpa.gov, (775) 589-5257.

Contributing Public Comment:

    •   Written: Please submit written comments by 3:00 p.m. the day before the meeting.
            o Email: You may email comments to publiccomment@trpa.gov. Include meeting details
                 and agenda item in the subject line or write "General Comment" for non-agenda items.
            o You may also send by mail, fax to (775) 588-4527, or drop off in person at 128 Market
                 Street.
    •   Verbal: Public comments are taken at the start and end of the meeting. Comments must be
        brief, non-repetitive, and within the time limits set by the Chair (usually three minutes per
        speaker/group, for a total maximum period of 45 minutes). Time may not be given to others.
        The Chair may further limit comments to keep the meeting on track.
            o Comment on agenda items → comment period at the beginning of the meeting.
            o Comment on any topic → comment period at the end of the meeting.
